service_dirs.description: List of directories to search for service definitions (e.g., /etc/finit.d/*.conf, /etc/init.d/).

default_runlevel.description: Default runlevel to enter at boot (e.g., S for single-user, 2 for multi-user without network, 3 for multi-user with network).

default_target.description: Alternative to runlevel: target unit to activate at boot (e.g., multi-user, graphical). Mutually exclusive with runlevel.

console_device.description: TTY device to use for init messages (e.g., /dev/console, tty0, ttyS0).

sync_on_shutdown.description: Whether to call sync() before reboot/halt to flush filesystem buffers.

plugins_enabled.description: Enable plugin support in Finit (requires compiled-in plugin support).

plugins_dir.description: Directory where Finit looks for loadable plugins (if plugins_enabled=true).

network_enabled.description: Enable automatic network interface bring-up via /etc/finit.d/network.conf hook.

hostname_enabled.description: Enable reading and setting system hostname from /etc/hostname.

plugins_config.description: Key-value pairs passed as configuration to loaded plugins (syntax: plugin <key> <value>).
